image_prompt.text: A large magical crystal orb floating at the centre of the spawn platform, composed so it reads as the hero piece of the lobby from the archway entrance and from both portals

A large circular light stone and marble spawn platform in pale blue and white, oriented so a joining player's first view is the floating crystal with the glowing portal wall behind it, never the back of the walls
An open circular waiting floor where players gather and idle before entering a game, sized for standing around rather than passing through
Two ornate portal doorways set into the back wall, one glowing blue and one glowing pink, clearly readable as the way out into the games
Four tall ornate pillars at the corners of the lobby, each capped with a glowing magical crystal in purple and cyan
An archway entrance at the front of the lobby, carved with decorative anime-style swirls and patterns
A notice and announcement board on one wall, a wooden frame around a paper-like panel
A high vaulted ceiling with lantern-style lights hanging from it in warm golden light
Stone walls enclosing the lobby on all sides, broken up with magical glow accents in soft purple and cyan

layout_placement.text: Spawn on the circular platform, facing the central crystal and the portal wall beyond it
Two portal gates on the back wall, each sending the player out to a separate game

notes: Route override: hub-portals and teleporter-link are both tagged P4, but the prompt scopes the build to one enclosed lobby room and says the portals are 'for game entry' — they lead to separate games, not to other zones of this build. Built as a single-zone P0 layout with teleport markers, which is the genre notes' own open question on hub portals. If the portals are meant to open further areas of this same map, it becomes P4.
Preset Hub taken as written — shape hub-portals with teleporter-link, social-hub and landmark-focal all present in the prompt. Only the route was changed; no preset option was dropped or substituted.
'Lobby' also appears under Party & Casual, but the prompt describes no rounds, minigames or match flow — only a waiting room with portals out — so that file was not loaded.

The five configurable attributes (floor colour, crystal glow colour, portal glow colour, lantern light colour, wall colour) are build parameters rather than layout features and no option covers them; the palette itself (soft purple, cyan, white, warm gold, clean blocky stylised anime-fantasy) is folded into the option text.

would have asked: Sounds like a portal hub — an open circular waiting floor, a floating crystal as the centrepiece over the spawn, and two clearly marked portal gates out to the games, plus the four crystal-topped pillars, the patterned archway, the notice board, the lantern ceiling and the glow-accented walls you listed. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?

would have asked: do those two portals send players into separate games, or into other areas of this same map? That decides whether this stays a single-room build or needs separate zones generated, which isn't ready yet.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
